svg.title: Kilometer Marker
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Fine construction contours are schematic; surface age/texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/kilometer-marker/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
